originalTitle: Cyberpunk 2077 - Official Edgerunners 2 Update Overview Trailer
content: Don't miss the Edgerunners 2 Update Overview Trailer for Cyberpunk 2077, the legendary sci-fi action RPG developed by CD Projekt Red. Players will soon gain access to the Edgerunners 2 Update, packed with a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Explore Night City in a whole new way with City Tours, new Tarot cards, Mod support, dual-wielding, and a suite of quality-of-life updates to the game. The Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077 is launching on October 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Mac, and PC (Steam). #Cyberpunk2077 #Gaming #IGN
